Title: Deaths
Description: People who died during or directly after the event as a direct result. Mutually exclusive with missing_persons.

Title: Missing persons
Description: People whose whereabouts are unknown since the event, including those presumed dead with no physical evidence and an official report filed. Mutually exclusive with death.

Title: Injured or ill
Description: People with new or exacerbated physical or psychological harm, trauma, or illness as a direct result.

Title: Displaced
Description: People displaced due to physical damage and disruption.

Title: Directly affected
Description: The estimated number of people directly affected by a disaster. What constitutes 'affected' should be defined by the risk project, and described in metadata.

Title: Dwellings damaged
Description: People residing in dwellings with non-structural damage; may remain habitable with repair.

Title: Dwellings destroyed
Description: People residing in dwellings levelled, collapsed, washed away, or otherwise uninhabitable and requiring full reconstruction.

Title: Livelihoods disrupted or destroyed
Description: People whose livelihoods were disrupted or destroyed. Component of ppl_affected. Definition of 'livelihoods disrupted' must be specified in project metadata.

Title: Buildings damaged
Description: Number, value or proportion of buildings damaged.

Title: Buildings destroyed
Description: Number, value or proportion of buildings destroyed.

Title: Infrastructure damaged
Description: Number, value or proportion of infrastructure damaged.

Title: Infrastructure destroyed
Description: Number, value or proportion of infrastructure destroyed.

Title: Direct damage to assets
Description: Estimated repair cost as currency or ratio. Single value or mean of a distribution.

Title: Damage index
Description: Index or classification of damage level; may be numeric or non-numeric.

Title: Exceedance probability
Description: Probability of reaching or exceeding a damage limit state in a fragility function.

Title: Loss
Description: Monetary value of economic impact: damage (replacement value of destroyed assets) plus losses (economic flows foregone due to asset absence). impact_type denotes total, direct, or indirect. loss_type denotes gross, ground-up, insured, etc.

Title: Downtime
Description: Duration of business or service interruption. Used in vulnerability modelling and observed loss estimation.

Title: Disruption
Description: Extent of disruption to businesses or services.

Title: Exposure to hazard
Description: People, infrastructure, housing, production capacities, or other tangible assets located in hazard-prone areas.

Title: Risk Index
Description: A specified index or classification of risk levels, which may be numeric or non-numeric.
